title: Shore To Have Fun | KEY.co
description_expanded: Entertainment and outdoor living take center stage throughout the property. A private heated pool and spa, summer kitchen, outdoor dining area, and fire pit create the perfect setting for relaxing afternoons and lively evenings. Inside, a dedicated game room with pinball machines, shuffleboard, and a PS5 adds another layer of fun for guests of all ages. The rooftop terrace offers beautiful Gulf views and a memorable space for sunset gatherings, while the included six-seater golf cart and six adult bikes make exploring Seagrove Beach and nearby Seaside effortless. With spacious suites, large bunk rooms, and room for up to 28 guests, this exceptional coastal home delivers the ideal backdrop for group vacations filled with connection, comfort, and coastal adventure. Just steps from the sand in Seagrove Beach, this expansive retreat is designed for unforgettable gatherings along scenic 30A. Spanning over 6,000 square feet across three levels plus a rooftop terrace, the home blends spacious living areas with thoughtful amenities that bring everyone together. The bright main living level features an open-concept design with a gourmet kitchen, generous dining space for large group meals, and comfortable seating for movie nights or conversation. Large windows fill the home with natural light, while nearby beach access and Gulf views create a constant connection to the coast.
